fact: As of June 2024 four social protection programmes (AMO-TADAMON, AMO ACHAMIL, MINHATY and the Direct Social Benefit) adopted the National Population Registry and Social Registry features to identify beneficiaries, and the DCSID is being integrated into the MIS of several programmes.
title: Morocco Second Identity and Targeting for Social Protection Project, Project Appraisal Document (Report No: PADHI00672)
